header.background: Full Stack Developer focused on building scalable, user-centered web solutions. I work across backend and frontend, designing REST APIs, dynamic interfaces, and data models, with a mindset of quality and continuous improvement.

about.about-text: I am a Full Stack Developer with experience in backend and frontend, working on web projects focused on scalable, user-centered solutions. I use JavaScript, TypeScript, and Java, with Spring Boot and Node.js on the backend, React and Angular on the frontend, and AWS. I have worked on collaborative projects using agile methods, building APIs, web interfaces, and databases. I am currently in my final term at ISIL.

experience.title-moru: Full Stack Developer at Moru App
experience.description1: I contributed to MoruApp, a platform that simplifies buying and selling products across different locations in Colombia, with features such as geolocation, user and business management, and reviews.
experience.description2: I helped build REST APIs, develop web interfaces, and manage the database. I worked with Scrum and supported task organization and technical coordination on the backend team.
experience.tec-back: Experience building server-side applications and systems with:
experience.tec-ai-desc: I use AI deliberately to speed up iteration, explore solutions, document, and review code, always validating, testing, and understanding what I integrate into the project.

contact.text: You can learn more about me and get in touch through these platforms:

projectsEN.name: Format Builder & Manager
projectsEN.description: Web application to create, edit, and manage custom formats through a spreadsheet-like interface. It includes folder organization, version control, and export. It communicates with services over HTTP and stores and consumes data from a real-time database, with a workflow designed for teams that need to standardize operational processes quickly.

projectsEN.name: Moru App
projectsEN.description: A platform that simplifies buying and selling products across different locations in Colombia. It includes geolocation, user and business management, and reviews. It is built with Node.js, Sequelize, and React.

projectsEN.name: Bookifa
projectsEN.description: A virtual bookstore with sign-in, category filters, sorting and pagination of the catalog, and book CRUD for authorized users. It includes favorites and a shopping cart, and uses lazy loading to optimize content loading.
